jobs.description: Do you have deep technical expertise, a strong affinity for data and enjoy getting to the bottom of complex analytical challenges? In this role, you will combine your technical expertise with data-driven analysis to identify correlations across test and manufacturing data and derive targeted measures to optimize the quality and yield of our products.Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Analyze and correlate data from parametric tests, functional tests and manufacturing processes using advanced analytical methods and tools- Identify and perform in-depth analyses of yield detractors related to design, test and technology, and derive appropriate improvement measures- Optimize product yield and quality and evaluate manufacturing experiments in close collaboration with experts from different technical areas- Analyze new products and take ownership of yield performance during volume production, including wafer disposition following functional testing- Develop and apply digitalization methods to efficiently analyze and evaluate complex technical data- Contribute to international product development projects and regularly report on yield performance and analysis results to internal and external stakeholdersYour profileYou enjoy digging deep into technical challenges and complex data, identifying patterns and correlations, and systematically investigating issues to understand their root causes. You combine strong analytical skills and technical curiosity with a high affinity for data, computers and digital tools. At the same time, you communicate your findings effectively and enjoy collaborating with experts across different functions.Qualifications and skills to help you succeed- A university degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry or a comparable technical discipline- At least 3–5 years of professional experience in the semiconductor industry, ideally in Product Engineering- Excellent Product Engineering expertise and experience in yield improvement, quality enhancement and physical failure analysis- Strong data affinity and analytical curiosity, with the motivation to dig deep into complex datasets and technical challenges and systematically investigate root causes- Experience in correlating different data sources and parameters, combined with strong computer and tool affinity- Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills, as well as confident communication in both English and German#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. **Do you enjoy bridging the gap between people and departments? Do you find it easy to communicate with different audiences and are interested in both the business and technical aspects of your work? Then we have the right position for you! Vestas is looking for a Plant Technical Support Engineer, Specialist (m/f/d)!**Region NCE and Global Offshore > NCE > Technical Operations North Technical Operations is part of Service NCE (Northern & Central Europe) and supports the organization in the installation and maintenance of a variety of SCADA systems for the control of medium- and large-scale wind turbines. Our mission is to transform a group of wind turbines into a fully operational power plant that meets contractual and regional requirements. Our customers are mainly larger energy supply companies and professional investors.Your tasks As a Plant Operations Specialist, you are the technical anchor point for the entire department. You will report directly to the Director and contribute to the strategic and technical direction of the division.- Maintain an overview of new research and development (R&D) products and accompany their operational implementation- Actively support technical escalations and risks for our business- Be the point of contact for our four technical communities and ensure that initiatives are aligned and add value to the business- Actively engage stakeholders and participate in global and regional communities- Advise management on technical gaps, priorities, regional risks, etc.Qualifications We are looking for candidates with proven leadership experience in a technical environment. This position does not focus primarily on your technical expertise, but on your ability to identify synergies, align stakeholders around common goals, and steer the technical agenda in a way that adds value to the business. You will be part of an operational department, but at the same time you will have the overarching perspective.- Degree or comparable educational background in information technology, automation technology or telecommunications- Strong leadership skills, for example as a project manager or manager- knowledge of the wind energy industry; Experience with SCADA systems is an advantage- Fluent in written and spoken EnglishCompetencies- Excellent communication skills as well as the ability to convey complex technical topics in an understandable way- Professional skills in stakeholder management- Ability to work independently and set the technical direction for a teamWhat we offer We offer an exciting job with excellent opportunities for professional and personal development in an inspiring, cooperative and international working environment within renewable energies. We attach great importance to initiative, a sense of responsibility and the right balance between creativity and quality in all solutions. With the appropriate motivation, performance and potential, you will have attractive career prospects within Vestas.Learn more Your primary place of work will be Aarhus or Videbæk in Denmark. Alternatively, Malmö (Sweden) as well as Husum or Hamburg (Germany) are also possible.You should expect to travel for about 20 days per year. If your skills and qualifications match this profile, we look forward to receiving your application in English by 20.09.2026 at the latest. Please note: We may adjust or withdraw our job postings and reserve the right to do so at any time, including before the specified application deadline.For more information on the position, please contact recruiter Rebecka Thorell at: rbthr@vestas.com

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH isthe joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the firsttime, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab inthe heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologiesfor next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a sharedcommitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. Forour future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated andcommitted: Hardware Engineer (m/w/d) Become the heart of our fabautomation. The Automated Material Handling System (AMHS) will be thenervous system of our fab. As an AMHS Hardware Engineer, you’ll be atechnical expert, designer, problem-solver, and team leader. You’llensure that our wafer transport systems (transfer tools, sorters, N2systems) operate at maximum efficiency. Tasks You will be responsiblefor the installation, commissioning, and continuous improvement of ourAMHS hardware. For complex issues, you will conduct root causeanalyses (8D, FMEA, SPC) and implement sustainable solutions. You willlead cross-functional projects aimed at improving productivity,quality, and cost efficiency—from planning through to performancereview. You will evaluate new equipment and materials, work closelywith suppliers, and develop in-house hardware solutions to meetoperational needs. You will lead and mentor a team of technicians andjunior engineers, share your knowledge, and foster team spirit throughclear communication. You will actively assist with installation andcoordinate upgrades in close collaboration with other departments.Profile You are a proactive team player who thrives in a dynamic,fast-paced environment and is willing to take on responsibility. AMaster’s degree in Engineering, such as Mechanical or ElectricalEngineering, Automation, or a related field. Professional experiencein the semiconductor industry is required. In-depth knowledge ofoptimization algorithms, control systems, and mechanical automation.Proficiency in quality tools such as SPC, FMEA, and 8Dproblem-solving. Hands-on mentality, resilience, and the ability tomotivate and lead teams professionally. Fluent in English (companylanguage). Basic communication skills in Mandarin or German is a plus.Available for on-the-job training in Taiwan, 9 to 12 months. We offerSecurity & Perspective: A permanent employment contract and careeradvancement opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductorsfabs. Company Pension Plan & Financial Benefits: We support yourfinancial well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMCemployee, you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance throughan exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Relocation Supportfor Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide you with all the supportyou will need for your relocation and your start in Dresden. Training& Development: Depending on your position, you will gain a deeperunderstanding of the processes involved in operating complexsemiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training at the TSMCNewcomer Training Center, while continuously expanding your knowledge.Health & Well-Being: An annual budget for your health and well-being(e.g., for sports classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stayfit.
